summary: Filebrowser provides a web-based file manager interface built with Material Design principles. It allows you to manage files and directories directly through your browser on a self-hosted server.
goodFor: This is a good fit if you need a lightweight web interface to manage files on a server without installing a full cloud storage stack.
watchOut: It overlaps heavily with standard SFTP clients and more complex cloud storage platforms, so ensure it fits your specific access control requirements before adopting it.
deployNotes: Being compiled in Go, it typically runs as a single static binary that can be deployed behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination, with persistent storage mapped to your file directories.
